goal: Prevent binary verification from counting expired or revoked GPG keys toward the quorum by default
Ensure release verification does not falsely pass when signatures come only from defunct or compromised keys
agreement: Objections settled but no explicit approvals yet
Concern that excluding expired keys breaks historical verification resolved via fallback flag (willcl-ark, sedited)
Open question whether unit tests should assert expired signature fields (willcl-ark)
Open suggestion to prompt users to update local keys periodically (willcl-ark)

categories.name: tools
why: P1 because it fixes a security flaw where revoked or expired keys satisfy the binary verification threshold
Protects release verifiers from treating binaries signed only by compromised or defunct keys as verified
